name: Uchi ni wa Tenshi ga Iru!
source:
There is an angel in my house.
IAnyway, it's cute. It's so cute that it doesn't hurt even if you put it in your eyes!!!

...... Tsumugi-kun (5th grade) and Yuri-san (OL) are just talking.

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/22537]Freem![/url]]
translation:
我家里住着一位天使。
总之，就是可爱。可爱到捧在手心里都觉得不够！

……这是一款只有小学五年级男生紬与上班族游梨女士聊天的游戏。

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/22537]Freem![/url]]
